name: cmdb_ci_customview
label: Custom View Associated with the Configuration Model Table
description: The configuration model custom view is associated with the table used for related queries in configuration management and other reporting scenarios.

fields.name: ci_id
fields.description: Model ID, used as the primary key or unique identifier for records in this table.

fields.name: customview_id
fields.description: Custom view ID, used as the primary key or unique identifier for records in this table.

indexes.name: PRIMARY
indexes.description: Primary key index covering the ci_id, customview_id fields, suitable for uniquely identifying records and queries that join the primary table.
